//: How the court looks when the match is played on another floor than the arena's turf (?floor=, review round 2 #15). Each entry overrides the arena's floor look (data/arenas.json floor); what it leaves out stays the arena's, so a blue hall keeps a blue hard court. hard: painted acrylic on concrete, no sand, no rolls, a satin finish (acrylic court coatings are sold as matte to satin). carpet: textile carpet without infill, laid in 2 m rolls (needle-punch sports carpet is made 2 m and 4 m wide). clay: brick dust over a crushed-stone base, terracotta with a paler dust, no rolls; padel isn't played on clay (the floor is the sim's fantasy option), so the look is a tennis clay court's.
